name: JC Clinic Chiangrai เจซีคลินิก เชียงราย

summary_en: JC Clinic Chiangrai, located in Chiang Rai, specializes in hair transplantation and Botox services. The clinic holds a 5-star rating based on 5 total reviews, with 3 discussions tracked from online platforms.
